**About Transverse Solutions**

Transverse Solutions is an eCommerce consultancy helping brands build, launch and grow their businesses online.

We work with D2C brands across Shopify, Amazon, Flipkart and other digital commerce platforms - bringing together eCommerce strategy, technology, performance marketing and conversion optimisation.

We are looking for a hands-on Performance Marketing & Marketplace Manager who can take ownership of the digital growth of our clients and, most importantly, help turn marketing activity into measurable sales.

**The Role**

This is not a social media management role.

And it is not a role where success is measured by how many campaigns were launched or how many reports were prepared. You will be responsible for growing sales for assigned eCommerce brands across: Shopify + Meta Ads + Google Ads + Amazon + Flipkart + Other Marketplaces.

You will independently plan, execute, monitor and optimise campaigns and marketplace operations for your assigned clients.

You will typically own 4 major client accounts at a time, with the possibility of supporting a few additional accounts on smaller requirements.

Your core question every day should be: *“What can we do today to sell more profitably than yesterday?”*

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Performance Marketing - Meta Ads

* Independently plan and execute Meta advertising campaigns for D2C brands.
* Develop acquisition, retargeting and remarketing strategies.
* Manage campaign structures, audiences, budgets and bidding strategies.
* Analyse campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Test different audiences, creatives, offers and campaign approaches.
* Scale campaigns that demonstrate sustainable performance.
* Identify and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns.
* Monitor key metrics including ROAS, CAC, CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR and revenue.
* Manage and optimise campaigns based on agreed client objectives.

2. Google Ads

* Plan, launch and manage Google Ads campaigns.
* Work across Search, Shopping and Performance Max as relevant.
* Manage keyword strategy, search terms, budgets and bidding.
* Monitor product/feed-related issues in coordination with the relevant team.
* Optimise campaigns based on conversion and revenue data.
* Identify opportunities for profitable scaling.
* Track and analyse Google Ads performance alongside Shopify sales data.

3. Shopify eCommerce Growth

While you will not be responsible for Shopify development, you will be responsible for understanding the sales funnel and identifying where marketing performance is being affected. You should be comfortable analysing: Ad → Landing Page → Product Page → Add to Cart → Checkout → Purchase

You will:

* Monitor Shopify sales and conversion metrics.
* Identify funnel drop-offs.
* Analyse product-level performance.
* Identify products that should be promoted or deprioritised.
* Recommend improvements to offers, promotions and campaigns.
* Work closely with our eCommerce/Shopify team when website or CRO issues are identified.
* Connect advertising performance with actual business revenue.

4. Amazon & Flipkart Management

Take end-to-end ownership of assigned marketplace accounts. Responsibilities include:

Marketplace account management.

Product catalogue management.

Listing optimisation.

Keyword optimisation.

Search visibility improvement.

Sponsored Ads / marketplace advertising.

Product-level sales analysis.

Campaign optimisation.

Promotions and deal planning.

Pricing and offer recommendations.

Identifying high-potential SKUs.

Identifying underperforming products.

Monitoring account health and operational issues.

Monitoring inventory-related issues and coordinating with clients.

Regularly analysing marketplace reports and identifying growth opportunities.

**Data, Analytics & Reporting**

You should be comfortable working with numbers.

You will be expected to:

\* Monitor daily/weekly/monthly performance.

\* Analyse advertising and sales data.

\* Track ROAS, CAC, conversion rate and revenue.

\* Identify trends and anomalies.

\* Prepare concise performance reports.

\* Translate data into actionable recommendations.

\* Explain why performance changed, not simply report what changed.

We don’t want dashboards full of numbers.

We want someone who can look at the numbers and say:

*“Here’s the problem. Here’s why it’s happening. Here’s what I’m going to do about it.”*

**Working With Our Internal Team**

You will work closely with:

Head – Digital Marketing

For digital strategy, SEO, marketplace expertise and overall marketing direction.

eCommerce / Shopify Team

For website, CRO, tracking and technical requirements.

Creative & Content Team

For ad creatives, content and campaign briefs.

Founder / Leadership

For client strategy, commercial priorities and growth planning.

You will be responsible for translating strategy into execution and measurable performance.

**What We’re Looking For**

*Must Have*

\* 2-4 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing/eCommerce.

\* Proven experience managing client brands, preferably D2C/eCommerce.

\* Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads.

\* Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads.

\* Experience managing Amazon and/or Flipkart accounts.

\* Good understanding of Shopify and the D2C sales funnel.

\* Strong understanding of ROAS, CAC, CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR and other performance metrics.

\* Ability to independently launch and optimise campaigns.

\* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.

\* Comfortable taking ownership of client performance.

\* Ability to work with multiple stakeholders and manage deadlines.

*Strong Advantage*

\* Experience scaling D2C brands.

\* Experience managing meaningful monthly ad budgets.

\* Experience with Amazon Sponsored Ads.

\* Experience with Flipkart Ads.

\* Experience with Google Shopping / Performance Max.

\* Experience with GA4, Google Merchant Center and Meta Pixel/CAPI.

\* Experience with quick-commerce platforms.

\* Experience working with fashion, beauty, food, toys, lifestyle or other consumer brands.

**The Person We’re Looking For**

*You could be a great fit if you:*

\* Think about sales, not just campaigns.

\* Enjoy looking at data and figuring out what’s wrong.

\* Don’t need to be told what to optimise.

\* Can independently manage an account from strategy to execution.

\* Are comfortable experimenting and testing.

\* Know that a campaign being “live” doesn’t mean it is successful.

\* Can explain performance in simple business terms.

\* Take ownership when numbers aren’t working.

\* Are curious about why customers buy - and why they don’t.

*You may NOT be the right fit if:*

\* Your primary experience is social media posting/community management.

\* You have only executed campaigns based on someone else’s instructions.

\* You primarily create reports without taking action on them.

\* You have never independently managed ad accounts.

\* You consider “campaign launched” to be the end of the job.

\* You are uncomfortable being accountable for measurable performance.

**How We Measure Success**

Your performance will ultimately be evaluated on the growth and efficiency of the accounts you manage. Key metrics may include:

* Revenue Growth
* ROAS / CAC
* Conversion Rate
* Paid Traffic Quality
* Marketplace Sales Growth
* Marketplace Advertising Efficiency
* Account Health

Execution Quality & Timeliness

The exact targets will vary by client depending on their category, product, pricing, margins, inventory, website and stage of growth.

**Compensation**

₹25,000-₹40,000 per month, depending on experience and demonstrated capability.

Additional performance incentives may be offered based on account-level performance and achievement of agreed targets.

**Why Join Transverse Solutions?**

You’ll get the opportunity to work on real eCommerce businesses, not just isolated advertising campaigns.

You’ll work across:

Shopify → Meta → Google → Amazon → Flipkart → Quick Commerce

and understand how all these channels come together to build an actual eCommerce business.

If you’re someone who gets excited when a client’s numbers move from:

₹5L → ₹8L → ₹12L

rather than simply getting excited about a campaign going live… we’d like to meet you.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONChief Operating Officer (COO) – Garment Manufacturing

**Company Name:** Lyallpur Emporium Pvt. Ltd.  
**Designation:** Chief Operating Officer (COO)  
**Department:** Operations  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director (MD)  
**Location:** Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Industry:** Garment Manufacturing – School Uniforms and Retail Apparel

1. JOB PURPOSE

The Chief Operating Officer (COO) will be responsible for overseeing and optimizing the company's overall operations, including garment manufacturing, production planning, merchandising, procurement, inventory management, quality control, warehousing, supply chain, and retail operations.

The role requires a strategic and result-oriented leader who can improve operational efficiency, control costs, ensure timely order execution, strengthen departmental coordination, and achieve the company's production and business objectives.

2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**A. Production & Manufacturing Management**

* Oversee end-to-end garment manufacturing operations, including cutting, stitching, embroidery, finishing, quality checking, packing, and dispatch.
* Develop and implement production plans based on sales forecasts, order requirements, and delivery schedules.
* Ensure achievement of monthly and annual production targets.
* Monitor production capacity, manpower utilization, machine efficiency, and production output.
* Identify production bottlenecks and implement corrective measures to improve productivity.
* Ensure timely completion of bulk orders and maintain production schedules.
* Monitor in-house and outsourced production activities, including job work and contractor performance.
* Establish productivity benchmarks and accountability for production teams.

**B. Merchandising & Order Management**

* Oversee merchandising activities from order confirmation to final dispatch.
* Ensure proper coordination between sales, merchandising, sampling, purchase, and production teams.
* Monitor sampling, product development, approvals, and production readiness.
* Ensure availability of fabrics, trims, accessories, and other materials before production commencement.
* Track order status, delivery commitments, and pending production requirements.
* Ensure timely execution of school uniform orders and other customer requirements.

**C. Supply Chain & Procurement Management**

* Oversee procurement planning for fabrics, accessories, trims, packaging materials, and other production requirements.
* Ensure timely purchase of materials at competitive prices without compromising quality.
* Establish vendor selection, evaluation, and performance monitoring procedures.
* Monitor purchase orders, material receipts, supplier lead times, and pending deliveries.
* Ensure appropriate approval procedures for purchase orders and vendor payments in coordination with the concerned departments.
* Develop reliable vendor and contractor networks.
* Minimize procurement delays and supply chain disruptions.

**D. Inventory & Warehouse Management**

* Oversee raw materials, work-in-progress (WIP), finished goods, and goods-in-transit (GIT) inventory.
* Ensure accurate inventory records and reconciliation between physical stock and system data.
* Implement regular stock audits and investigate shortages, excess stock, and inventory discrepancies.
* Monitor material issuance, returns, transfers, and consumption.
* Establish controls to minimize fabric wastage, material loss, dead stock, and excess inventory.
* Ensure proper documentation of goods receipts, material movements, job work, and dispatches.
* Maintain optimum inventory levels based on production requirements and sales demand.

**E. Quality Control & Compliance**

* Establish quality standards at every stage of garment manufacturing.
* Ensure quality inspections for incoming materials, in-process production, and finished garments.
* Monitor rejection rates, rework, customer complaints, and product defects.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce quality issues.
* Ensure products meet approved specifications, size charts, fitting requirements, and customer expectations.
* Monitor compliance with applicable factory, labour, safety, and environmental requirements.
* Coordinate with HR, Admin, and relevant specialists to address statutory and operational compliance matters.

**F. Retail Operations & Sales Coordination**

* Oversee operational performance of company-operated uniform retail stores.
* Monitor store-wise sales, stock availability, replenishment, inventory accuracy, and customer service.
* Coordinate with retail, warehouse, merchandising, and production teams to prevent stockouts.
* Review store performance, slow-moving inventory, and seasonal sales requirements.
* Ensure timely replenishment of school uniforms according to seasonal demand.
* Implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) for store operations, stock handling, and reporting.
* Coordinate with the sales and marketing teams to align production and inventory with business demand.

**G. Cost Control & Financial Efficiency**

* Monitor manufacturing costs, material consumption, labour costs, overtime, job-work charges, and operational expenses.
* Identify opportunities to reduce production costs and improve operating margins.
* Monitor wastage, rework, rejection costs, and avoidable operational expenditure.
* Work with Finance and Accounts to prepare operating budgets and review actual expenses against budgets.
* Track departmental costs and implement cost-control measures.
* Evaluate operational investments and recommend initiatives that improve productivity and profitability.

**H. ERP, MIS & Process Automation**

* Ensure effective utilization of the company's ERP/software systems for production, inventory, procurement, and order tracking.
* Establish accurate and timely operational reporting across departments.
* Monitor system data accuracy and ensure that material movements and production transactions are properly recorded.
* Implement standardized workflows for job cards, purchase orders, goods receipts, material issuance, and dispatches.
* Develop dashboards and MIS reports for management review.
* Identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and better operational control.

**I. Team Leadership & Departmental Coordination**

* Lead and coordinate Production, Merchandising, Purchase, Inventory, Warehouse, Quality, and other assigned operational functions.
* Define departmental goals, key performance indicators (KPIs), and individual accountability.
* Conduct regular performance reviews with department heads.
* Improve coordination between manufacturing, sales, retail, finance, HR, and administration.
* Identify training requirements and strengthen the capabilities of operational teams.
* Build a culture of ownership, discipline, transparency, and continuous improvement.
* Resolve operational escalations and ensure timely completion of assigned responsibilities.

**J. Strategic Planning & Management Reporting**

* Translate the Managing Director's business objectives into actionable operational plans.
* Prepare annual, quarterly, and monthly operating plans.
* Review production performance, order fulfilment, inventory, costs, quality, and departmental productivity.
* Present periodic operational performance reports to the Managing Director.
* Identify operational risks and develop contingency plans.
* Recommend capacity expansion, process improvements, resource allocation, and business efficiency initiatives.
* Drive continuous improvement across manufacturing and retail operations.

3. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

The COO's performance will be evaluated against mutually agreed business targets, including:

* **Production Achievement:** Actual production against approved monthly targets.
* **On-Time Delivery:** Percentage of customer orders dispatched within committed timelines.
* **Production Efficiency:** Output per employee, line efficiency, and capacity utilization.
* **Manufacturing Cost:** Cost per garment against approved standards.
* **Material Utilization:** Fabric and accessory consumption against approved consumption norms.
* **Quality Performance:** Rejection rate, rework percentage, and customer complaints.
* **Inventory Accuracy:** Accuracy of physical stock against ERP records.
* **Inventory Control:** Reduction in excess stock, shortages, dead stock, and unexplained inventory variances.
* **Procurement Efficiency:** Purchase cost, supplier lead time, and material availability.
* **Order Fulfilment:** Timely completion of orders against confirmed requirements.
* **Retail Performance:** Store-wise sales performance, stock availability, and replenishment efficiency.
* **Cost Control:** Achievement of approved operating budgets and reduction in avoidable expenditure.
* **ERP Compliance:** Accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of operational transactions and MIS reporting.
* **Team Performance:** Achievement of departmental targets and timely closure of operational issues.
* **Process Improvement:** Successful implementation of measurable productivity, quality, and cost-saving initiatives.

4. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor's degree in Textile Technology, Garment Manufacturing, Apparel Production, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field.
* MBA in Operations, Supply Chain Management, or Business Administration will be an added advantage.

5. EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

* 12–18 years of relevant experience in garment manufacturing, apparel production, or textile operations.
* At least 5 years in a senior leadership position, such as Head of Operations, General Manager – Operations, Plant Head, or COO.
* Experience managing multiple departments and large operational teams.
* Proven experience in production planning, merchandising coordination, procurement, inventory control, quality management, and cost optimization.
* Experience in school uniforms, institutional apparel, or seasonal garment businesses will be preferred.
* Experience managing both in-house manufacturing and outsourced job work will be an advantage.

6. REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

* Strong leadership and people management skills.
* Excellent knowledge of garment manufacturing processes.
* Strong production planning and execution capabilities.
* Expertise in supply chain, procurement, and inventory management.
* Financial understanding and cost-control capabilities.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Experience with ERP systems and operational MIS.
* Excellent coordination, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple departments and meet strict delivery deadlines.
* Strong focus on operational discipline, process improvement, and business profitability.

7. AUTHORITY & ACCOUNTABILITY

The COO will be accountable for operational performance within the authority delegated by the Managing Director.

The role includes:

* Recommending production plans, manpower requirements, and resource allocation.
* Reviewing and monitoring departmental budgets and operating expenses.
* Evaluating supplier, contractor, and departmental performance.
* Recommending process changes and cost-saving initiatives.
* Ensuring adherence to approved SOPs and internal control procedures.
* Escalating significant financial, operational, compliance, and business risks to the Managing Director.
* Ensuring that operational decisions and expenditure remain within approved budgets and delegated authority.

8. EXPECTED OUTCOMES

The successful candidate is expected to:

* Establish a structured and accountable operational system.
* Improve production planning and delivery performance.
* Reduce manufacturing costs, wastage, and rework.
* Strengthen inventory accuracy and material control.
* Improve coordination between manufacturing, merchandising, procurement, warehouse, and retail teams.
* Enhance ERP adoption and operational reporting.
* Improve departmental productivity and accountability.
* Support sustainable business growth and profitability.
